derivation: from a derivative of a compound of G435 (ἀνήρ) and G4228 (πούς);
def: an enslaver (as bringing men to his feet)

occurrences.text: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
